name: AlgZoo longest-cycle transformer (hidden 8, length 6)
arch:
A 2-layer attention-only transformer: no MLPs, no LayerNorm, no biases, one head per layer, no attention mask (every position attends to every position). Vocabulary 6 tokens, sequences of 6 tokens, residual width 8.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos                      W_E: 6 x 8, W_pos: 6 x 8
  per layer l: x = x + softmax(q k^T / sqrt(8)) v W_O,  q = x W_Q, k = x W_K, v = x W_V  (each 8 x 8)
  out = x[last position] @ W_U                 W_U: 8 x 6
656 parameters. The output is a score per class; the decision is the largest.
context: Each input is a function f on {0..5}: token i is f(i). Output class c stands for 'the longest cycle of f has length c + 1' (follow i -> f(i) -> f(f(i)) ... until it returns).

answer.short: length of the longest cycle of the input function, minus 1
answer.detail: AlgZoo longest_cycle, hidden 8, length 6, seed 3; accuracy 0.8538 on all 46656 inputs. No published interpretation found (searched Nov 17, 2026).

domain.text: Every possible input: all 6**6 = 46656 functions on {0..5}.
